claim_text: While airing a Gilad Kariv speech clip, Varon said that when he 'switches to speaking Arabic' the message changes, contrasting what he says in Hebrew with what he supposedly says in Arabic.
discovery_source: Channel 14 exact Morning Edition segment https://www.c14.co.il/article/1665806 ; Walla https://e.walla.co.il/item/3861730 ; ICE https://www.ice.co.il/media/news/article/1126106
resolution_notes: Accepted as False / High confidence, narrowly on the language shown in the clip. Channel 14's own page preserves the exact segment and wording; Walla directly reports that Kariv was speaking Hebrew and Arabic appeared only as subtitles, with ICE independently corroborating the translated-subtitle context. The broader political opinion about tailoring messages to audiences is not adjudicated.
media_status: Exact original Channel 14 embedded video recovered and recorded as C14MED-2026-0008. Stable GitHub exact-frame preview extraction was attempted but Blocked; no generic or related imagery substituted.
